meta.source: Lawrence's Pulse email signature (HTML/CSS, exact values) for color, depth and shadow; the dark amber dashboard reference image for layout. Signature values are exact; layout values are derived.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The desk the hardware sits on: app canvas behind every chassis.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed screens cut into a face: charts, KPIs, media, tables that read as displays.

tokens.name: slab-dark
tokens.usage: Dark layer in a chassis edge stack (alternates with slab-mid).

tokens.name: slab-mid
tokens.usage: Mid layer in a chassis edge stack (alternates with slab-dark).

tokens.name: panel-side
tokens.usage: Side rails and the darker half of a face: icon rails, sidebars, panel headers.

tokens.name: face
tokens.usage: The main chassis face: cards, panels, top bar.

tokens.name: face-raised
tokens.usage: Raised keys and controls standing on a face; hover on rows.

tokens.name: face-high
tokens.usage: Top of a raised ramp: pressed-state highlight, selected rows on a well.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Chassis outline and dividers between face sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: edge-hi
tokens.usage: First slab under a face: the bright machined edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline keys. Holds 3:1 on well, panel-side and face.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and links (signature contact line) on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Icons, meta, axis values (signature social icons) on every surface except face-high.

tokens.name: pulse-yellow
tokens.usage: Pulse yellow from the logo and signature. Primary keys, active indicators, corner brackets, scan lines, the focus ring, the one highlighted series. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: pulse-yellow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of yellow fills.

tokens.name: pulse-yellow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of yellow fills.

tokens.name: pulse-yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind yellow text: selected nav, yellow chips on a well, chart range highlight.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 20px blueprint grid etched into a chassis face (signature).

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pulse-yellow fills (title chip, primary keys).

tokens.name: metal-100
tokens.usage: Chrome highlight: ring strokes, knob caps, comparison chart line. Graphic use.

tokens.name: metal-300
tokens.usage: Brushed metal mid tone: inactive series, slider tracks' fill for context.

tokens.name: metal-500
tokens.usage: Shadowed metal: inactive thumbs, disabled strokes.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Rare second accent: a second data series, premium tier, featured room.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Paid, confirmed, gains. Always with a sign, arrow or word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind positive chips.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Overdue, cancelled, losses, destructive actions. Always with a sign, arrow or word.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind negative chips.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system notices only. Not a brand color.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info chips.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline on a dashboard stage. One per screen.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Section titles inside a chassis, list item names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta, helper text, timestamps (the signature contact size).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase chip text and kickers (the signature title chip).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; well inset from a face edge is space-2 minus 3px (5px).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, key padding (small).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Chassis padding, key padding, field gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid pitch of the etched face grid; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between chassis on a dashboard (room for their slab edges and drop shadows).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins.

tokens.name: well-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between a chassis edge and the well cut into it (signature).

tokens.name: bezel
tokens.usage: Width of the bevelled bezel strip on the left of a raised module (signature).

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: Screens inside wells, chips, keys, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-well
tokens.usage: Recessed wells and key banks.

tokens.name: radius-chassis
tokens.usage: Every chassis (card, panel, sidebar) and its slab stack.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Slider thumbs, status LEDs.

tokens.name: shadow-slab
tokens.usage: The signature's six-layer slab stack plus drop shadow: the 3D edge of every chassis. One per chassis.

tokens.name: shadow-lip
tokens.usage: Machined lip on a raised face or module: light top edge, dark bottom edge.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: A well pressed into the face, catching light on its lower and right rim.

tokens.name: shadow-screen
tokens.value: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), inset 3px 4px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), inset -1px -1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)
tokens.usage: Glass screen set inside a well: charts, media, KPI readouts.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: A raised hardware key: two-slab edge and a short drop.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: A key pushed into the face; pair with translate(1px, 2px).

tokens.name: glow-yellow
tokens.usage: Scan lines and live LEDs (signature scan).

tokens.name: glow-yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Accent bars, the text cursor, active indicators (signature bar).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs floating above chassis.

depth.note: The slab stack recipe from the signature: each layer offsets by step-x and step-y, alternating slab-dark and slab-mid, under an edge-hi first layer.

tokens.name: depth-step-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal offset per slab layer.

tokens.name: depth-step-y
tokens.usage: Vertical offset per slab layer.

tokens.name: depth-layers
tokens.usage: Slab layers under a chassis; raised modules on a chassis add 2 more.

tokens.name: boot-fade
tokens.usage: Chassis surfaces fading in on load (signature bgIn).

tokens.name: scan-sweep
tokens.usage: One yellow scan line across a chassis after boot.

tokens.name: key-press
tokens.usage: Key press and release.
